gloss: to tighten; to brace; to firm up

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {引|ひ}き{締|し}めませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {引|ひ}き{締|し}めていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {引|ひ}き{締|し}めていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to tighten; to pull tight; to firm up
definitions.explanation: To make something physically tighter or more toned, such as muscles or a body.

definitions.gloss: to brace oneself; to tighten discipline; to buckle down
definitions.explanation: To adopt a more serious, focused attitude. Often used about mental or organizational discipline.

examples.japanese: {体|からだ}を{引|ひ}き{締|し}めたい。
examples.english: I want to tone my body.

examples.japanese: このクリームは{肌|はだ}を{引|ひ}き{締|し}める{効果|こうか}がある。
examples.english: This cream has a skin-tightening effect.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}ジョギングをして、{少|すこ}しずつ{体|からだ}を{引|ひ}き{締|し}めている。
examples.english: I jog every morning and am gradually toning my body.

examples.japanese: {気|き}を{引|ひ}き{締|し}めて{頑張|がんば}ろう。
examples.english: Let's buckle down and do our best.

examples.japanese: {試合前|しあいまえ}に{監督|かんとく}が{選手|せんしゅ}たちの{気持|きも}ちを{引|ひ}き{締|し}めた。
examples.english: Before the match, the coach braced the players' spirits.

examples.japanese: {新年度|しんねんど}を{迎|むか}えるにあたり、{財政|ざいせい}を{引|ひ}き{締|し}める{方針|ほうしん}が{発表|はっぴょう}された。
examples.english: A policy to tighten finances was announced ahead of the new fiscal year.

notes:
{引|ひ}き{締|し}める is a transitive ichidan verb. It is a compound of {引|ひ}く (to pull) and {締|し}める (to tighten).

ASPECT (ている):
{引|ひ}き{締|し}めている indicates an ongoing process of tightening, or a resulting toned/disciplined state.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [object]を{引|ひ}き{締|し}める (to tighten something)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {体|からだ}を{引|ひ}き{締|し}める (to tone one's body)
- {気|き}を{引|ひ}き{締|し}める (to brace oneself, to get serious)
- {財政|ざいせい}を{引|ひ}き{締|し}める (to tighten finances)
- {表情|ひょうじょう}を{引|ひ}き{締|し}める (to set one's expression firmly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {引|ひ}き{締|し}める: to tighten, to tone (emphasizes pulling tight)
- {締|し}める: to tighten, to close (simpler, more general)
- {緩|ゆる}める: to loosen (antonym)
